coords: x,y are stall centers in image pixels. w is frontage along the row; h is stall depth. rotation is degrees of the +w (along-row) axis, SVG convention (positive clockwise, y-down), around the center.
method: Space numbers and counts were read from the facility's published site-plan image (images/unit-map.jpg, 1200×1109). Mid rows and the east column were aligned by rotating the plan 18.43° so the canopy rows sat horizontal, then each building outline was divided into equal stall boxes matching the printed numbers. The west (400s) column was measured directly on the original (nearly vertical) image. Boxes were mapped back to original image coordinates. Positions are close enough for this demo; they may be off by a few pixels versus the printed outlines. 367 numbered stalls were mapped, plus two wash-bay stalls labeled W and B (shown as an amenity, not as rentable spaces). The site publishes 362 covered spots, so the plan count is slightly higher.
